```lean
theorem lg_target {r x : ℝ} : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x := by
  constructor
  rw [Real.exp_neg]
  apply HasDerivAt.const_rpow (0 < r)
  apply HasDerivAt.of_real_cpow_const r (r ≠ 0)
  exact Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
  rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg]
  exact Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
```
